compiler.content:
PRODUCT FIDELITY RULES (non-negotiable):
- Use the attached reference product image EXACTLY as shown
- Do NOT redraw, recolor, or alter the product appearance in any way
- The product must remain photorealistic and true to the reference

META ANDROMEDA & GEM MULTIMODAL ALGORITHM RULES:
- The creative IS the targeting: craft specific personas, problems, and environments so Meta's vector retrieval finds the exact buyer cluster
- Transcript scanning: Meta auto-transcribes every video ad. The spoken dialogue/voiceover must explicitly speak to the target persona in their authentic tone
- Multimodal coherence: Visuals, spoken audio, and text overlays must tell one cohesive story, never competing messages
- Entity ID & Similarity protection: Avoid generic or near-duplicate layouts; ensure genuine concept diversity across Persona × Angle × Offer

HINDI AUDIO & PRONUNCIATION SAFEGUARD (CRITICAL FOR VIDEO CREATIVES):
- All spoken dialogue and voiceovers MUST be written in natural, conversational Hindi (in Devanagari script, e.g., 'अगर आपकी चांदी की ज्वेलरी भी 2 हफ़्ते में काली पड़ जाती है...')
- This guarantees AI voice tools (ElevenLabs, Google TTS, Veo) and voice artists pronounce words, stress, and inflections accurately without butchering Indian diction
- Provide phonetic Hinglish transliteration alongside for production reference

BANNER AD STRATEGIC ARCHITECTURE (PRINCIPALLY IDENTICAL TO VIDEO):
- Persona × Problem × Angle × Offer: Every banner is built on the same strategic quadriad and Eugene Schwartz awareness level
- Banner 3-Layer Hook:
  * Layer 1 (Visual Hook): Scroll-stopping hero composition, problem/solution split, or macro craftsmanship
  * Layer 2 (Andromeda Copy): Primary ad text specifically tuned for Meta's vector categorization
  * Layer 3 (On-Screen Text): Safe-zone headline, proof badge (e.g. 'Hallmarked 925'), and margin-safe offer badge
- Advertorial & Long-form Statics: Highly effective for problem-aware cold audiences by moving them from pain to solution in a single frame
- Real Product Image Anchor: Strict non-negotiable rule. Product must match actual inventory.

8–10 SECOND VIDEO LIMIT & 2-PART STRUCTURE (GOOGLE VEO / FLOW CONSTRAINTS):
- Single-clip video models (Veo, Google Flow, Kling) are capped at 8–10 seconds
- When extended duration is required, write scripts in MAX 2 PARTS (8–10s each):
  * Part 1 (0–9s): The 3-Layer Hook, Problem Agitation & The Bridge
  * Part 2 (9–18s): Product Reveal (exact reference match), Unique Mechanism, Proof & Margin-Safe Offer with CTA
- Consistency Anchors: Part 1 and Part 2 MUST lock the identical AI Character Seed, lighting temperature (e.g., 4500K), wardrobe, setting, and color grade

THE BRIDGE & TRANSITION:
- Never do an abrupt 'product drop'. Smoothly guide the viewer from problem agitation into the reason why past solutions failed, then introduce the product naturally

PROOF HIERARCHY & PERSUASION:
- Persuasion follows the proof ladder: 1. Visual Demonstration > 2. Clinical / Lab Data > 3. Real Customer Testimonials > 4. Founder Assertion
- Always pair product promises with an explicit Unique Mechanism (the 'reason to believe')

FINANCIAL & COMPLIANCE GUARDRAILS:
- Show only the price and offer that match the live product page
- Never display cost price or internal margin data
- Discount percentage must match actual MRP vs SP calculation
- Keep text within safe zones (10% margin on all edges), legible at mobile resolution (min 16px equivalent)
- No competitor logos, inflated crossed-out prices, or non-compliant medical claims

product_hero.content: Product Hero logic: Center the product with clear lighting. Focus on material texture, shine, and craftsmanship. Clean studio environment with minimal distraction. Best for solution-aware and product-aware audiences where single-frame visual value is high.

problem_solution.content: Problem-Solution logic: Establish the relatable pain point or emotional friction in the visual cue and spoken hook. Use Eugene Schwartz consequence-naming (3-12s). Bridge smoothly to the product as the effortless, definitive solution backed by a unique mechanism.

ugc_creator.content: UGC & Creator-Led logic: Relatable customer perspective with an authentic Indian character. Handheld smartphone composition, natural domestic/lifestyle lighting, conversational first-person narrative. High trust, low ad fatigue.

contrarian_educational.content: Contrarian & Educational logic: Challenge industry myths (e.g. 'Everything you were told about X is wrong'). Open a curiosity gap and provide domain expertise before introducing the product mechanism.

offer_led.content: Offer-Led logic: Emphasize maximum value perception for high-intent/most-aware audiences. High contrast discount badge and pricing clarity, while keeping the product premium and desirable. Tied to clear margin guardrails.

lifestyle.content: Lifestyle logic: Place the product in authentic, aspirational day-to-day Indian settings. Focus on emotion, aesthetic mood, and natural styling matching target persona age and context.

testimonial_proof.content: Testimonial & Social Proof logic: Feature authentic customer belief changes, objection handling (e.g., 'I nearly didn't buy because...'), and specific quantified results (Claude Hopkins specificity).

gifting.content: Gifting logic: Emotional resonance around special moments (festivals, anniversaries, birthdays), thoughtful unboxing presentation, gift box aesthetics, addressing gifting anxiety.

Jewellery.content: Jewellery Pack: Emphasize 925 sterling silver stamp, rhodium shine, anti-tarnish coating, skin-safe hypoallergenic properties. Indian urban styling, festive and workwear versatility. Props: velvet trays, marble slabs, soft silk fabric, warm directional light.

Fashion.content: Fashion Pack: Emphasize fabric texture, drape, fit versatility, breathable weave, comfort in Indian climate. Contemporary Indian ethnic and western fusion. Props: architectural arches, neutral backdrops, daylight studio.

Beauty & Personal Care.content: Beauty Pack: Clean dermatological look, hydration droplets, ingredient botanical cues, fresh morning light. Address specific Indian skin concerns (pigmentation, tanning, humidity, sensitive scalp).

Home & Kitchen.content: Home Pack: Modern Indian apartment/home setting, functional kitchen counter, ambient warmth, durable utility, space efficiency.

default.content: Default Pack: Clean modern product showcase, studio gradient background, high-contrast typography, premium lighting, Indian cultural context.
